title: Discontinuity of the q-State Potts Phase Transition on Z^d for d >= 3 and q >= 3
exact_target: Does every nearest-neighbor Potts model with at least three spin states in dimension at least three acquire long-range order discontinuously at its transition?

sources.citation: H. Duminil-Copin, 'Lectures on the Ising and Potts models on the hypercubic lattice', arXiv:1707.00520 (2017), in Random Graphs, Phase Transitions and the Gaussian Free Field, Springer PIMS 123 (2020).
